title: ArrythML-II: An Optimized TinyML Framework for ECG Arrhythmia Detection and Multi-Class Beat Classification on Wearable Devices
abstract: arXiv:2611.28791v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents ArrythML-II, an optimized TinyML framework for on-device ECG arrhythmia detection and multi-class beat classification on wearable platforms. A systematic hyperparameter optimization framework is developed to identify compact autoencoder architectures for binary ECG arrhythmia detection. A custom scoring mechanism jointly considers detection performance, reconstruction-error thresholds, and model size to guide architecture selection. The framework is further extended to six-class ECG beat classification using a lightweight classifier derived from the optimized autoencoder architecture. Both models are INT8 quantized and deployed using TensorFlow Lite Micro on a custom-developed, battery-operated, single-lead ECG device based on the PSoC~6 microcontroller. The deployed autoencoder and classifier have model sizes of approximately 44~KB and 22~KB, respectively, with end-to-end processing times of 5.1~ms and 4.7~ms per ECG

translated_title: ArrythML-II：一种面向可穿戴设备上心电图心律失常检测与多类心跳分类的优化TinyML框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了ArrythML-II，一个针对可穿戴平台上设备端心电图（ECG）心律失常检测与多类心跳分类的优化TinyML框架。该研究开发了一个系统化的超参数优化框架，用于寻找紧凑的自编码器架构以实现二分类ECG心律失常检测，并设计了一种自定义评分机制，综合考虑检测性能、重构误差阈值和模型大小来指导架构选择。该框架进一步扩展至六分类ECG心跳分类任务，采用了从优化后的自编码器架构衍生的轻量级分类器。两个模型均经过INT8量化，并使用TensorFlow Lite Micro部署在一款自主开发的、基于PSoC 6微控制器的电池供电单导联ECG设备上。部署后的自编码器和分类器模型大小分别约为44 KB和22 KB，每条ECG的端到端处理时间分别为5.1毫秒和4.7毫秒。
tldr: 本文提出优化TinyML框架ArrythML-II，通过系统化超参数优化与自定义评分机制构建紧凑自编码器和轻量级分类器，实现了可穿戴设备上的ECG心律失常检测与六类心跳分类，模型仅44 KB和22 KB、处理时间约5毫秒。
en_tdlr: ArrythML-II is an optimized TinyML framework that leverages systematic hyperparameter optimization and a custom scoring mechanism to build a compact autoencoder and a lightweight classifier, enabling on-device ECG arrhythmia detection and six-class beat classification on wearables with model sizes of only 44 KB and 22 KB and processing times of about 5 ms.
